services.name: Day Sail
services.desc: Adults: $50 (Ages 11+)Children: $50 (Ages 3 - 10)Infants / Toddlers: FREE (Ages 0-2) Our most popular sail of the day. Watch the sun set over the Pacific from Waikiki’s longest-running catamaran, a boat that’s been making this same journey since 1977. Whether you’re with someone special, your family, or a group of friends, the sunset sail turns strangers into fast friends every single evening. BYOB welcome, or grab a cold drink from our onboard cash bar. Catamaran Kepoikai II departs from the beach for all of our sails, so be sure to bring footwear that you can easily slip on and off! For any guests with mobility issues, please let one of the crew members know ahead of time so they can help

services.name: Sunset Sail
services.desc: Experience the night-lights and beautiful sunsets of Honolulu from a whole new perspective! Duration: 1 hour About A great evening for couples, families and large groups! Catamaran sailing is one of the best ways to sit back, relax, and just take in the beautiful scenery of Waikiki Beach and the ocean surrounding it. Let the ocean be your sanctuary away from it all and take a relaxing catamaran sail aboard the Kepoikai II Catamaran. Escape the ordinary aboard this beautiful vessel, head out into the open ocean, and feel the stresses of daily life being washed

checkin: Aloha! Mahalo for choosing Catamaran Kepoikai II! We look forward to having you aboard as our guest! We're located on the shoreline of Waikiki Beach between the Royal Hawaiian Hotel and the main Outrigger Waikiki Beach Hotel, in front of Dukes Waikiki. Please be on the shoreline at least 10 - 15 Minutes prior to your sail time for check-in.
cancellation: Cancellation Policy Customers with individual or small group bookings (1–5 guests) will receive a full refund with at least 24 hours’ notice of cancellation. For groups of 6 or more guests, or when booking more than 50% of available spots, a minimum of 72 hours’ notice is required to receive a full refund. NO REFUNDS FOR LAST-MINUTE CANCELLATIONS OR NO SHOWS!
